ELDRICK.com | Austin, TX / Remote | Hiring Founding AI Engineer + Videographer

ELDRICK is the world’s #1 AI golf club fitter, trained on 80,000 real club fittings. We’re building an AI-powered golf fitting platform using real data to replace guesswork and brand bias.

OPEN ROLES:

FOUNDING AI ENGINEER (GENERALIST) Austin, TX preferred | REMOTE (strong candidates) Comp: $200k+ base + equity

Founding-level role working directly with founders on core AI systems. Build end-to-end AI translating golfer inputs, swing data, and fitting history into equipment recommendations. Looking for strong applied AI/ML or LLM experience, generalist mindset, product instincts. Must be a golfer — include your handicap in the email.

VIDEOGRAPHER / SHORT-FORM CONTENT CREATOR Fort Wayne, IN | ONSITE Comp: $50k–$75k base

Shoot and edit short-form video (TikTok/Reels/Shorts). CapCut required. Familiar with AI tools like Midjourney or Kling. Junior-to-mid level. Golf interest a plus.

Apply: hi@eldrick.golf
